strings.en:
To Sister Tiara.{1a}Forgive me, Sister. I am a coward. I can
no longer bear this pain and the dread of
death closing in.{1a}But even I have a man's pride. I have my
honor as a knight. Let me die at the last
not in a bed, but as an adventurer.{1a}In this peaceful age, I was born to the
station of knight, whose worth should
exist only in battle,{1a}and I was languishing day after day
without so much as a decent office
when Kars Bastide gave me real life.{1a}The 3 years since I came to this town
were the fullest of my life.{1a}Laugh, and call it a poor life. In this town,
for the first time since I was born, I felt
what it is to be alive.{1a}But after losing the use of my body in
the accident a year and a half ago, I
sank into a pitiful man who wallows in the
memories of those mere 3 years.{1a}When I finish writing this letter, I will
head for the ruins.{1a}I mean to visit, one by one, my memories
of my friends, now gone, all killed in that
accident a year and a half ago.{1a}With this body... I do not know how far I
can walk, but surely I will not come back
alive.{1a}Yet strangely my heart is at peace. I
feel no fear at all. Even the pain that
tormented me so is now like an old friend.{1a}But I may have trampled on your
kindness and compassion, Sister, your
wish that my end be peaceful. That alone
I regret.{1a}Truly, forgive me. But I am grateful from
my heart for your devoted care.{1a}You may not welcome this, but please
accept my sword. It should sell for a fair
price. Use it to help with the Church's
funds.{1a}As an adventurer, Lorenzo Federico{0c:fe}

Let me die at the last not in a bed, but as an adventurer. // In this peaceful age, I was born to the station of knight, whose worth should exist only in battle, // and I was languishing day after day without so much as a decent office when Kars Bastide gave me real life. // The 3 years since I came to this town were the fullest of my life. // Laugh, and call it a poor life. In this town, for the first time since I was born, I felt what it is to be alive. // But after losing the use of my body in the accident a year and a half ago, I sank into a pitiful man who wallows in the memories of those mere 3 years. // When I finish writing this letter, I will head for the ruins. // I mean to visit, one by one, my memories of my friends, now gone, all killed in that accident a year and a half ago. // With this body... I do not know how far I can walk, but surely I will not come back alive. // Yet strangely my heart is at peace. I feel no fear at all. Even the pain that tormented me so is now like an old friend. // But I may have trampled on your kindness and compassion, Sister, your wish that my end be peaceful. That alone I regret. // Truly, forgive me. But I am grateful from my heart for your devoted care. // You may not welcome this, but please accept my sword. It should sell for a fair price. Use it to help with the Church's funds. // As an adventurer, Lorenzo Federico
Tiara-san...
Men really are simple. // [1]Bring out a word like pride or honor and they get drunk on themselves... // They're nothing but fools.
Eve!
Get drunk all you like... But you could spare a thought for the ones left behind. // In the end they can only think of themselves. Narcissism at its finest, isn't it?
